description: Standalone Alaska active-license app jobs with explicit retained-release verification or fixed native acquisition. Historical source contract and manifests remain unchanged.

retainedManifest.description: Explicit immutable local Alaska release; verify without downloading or changing its pointer.

redirect_policy: Reject redirects; fixed HTTPS BusinessLicenseDownload and NaicsDownload CSV endpoints. Retained verification performs no network calls.
retry: Four serial attempts per response; honor Retry-After without shortening, defer waits exceeding one day. Never retry a partially consumed CSV body. No automatic job restart.
checkpoint: Exclusive UUID job with durable start and terminal receipts. Successful receipt binds verified immutable source manifest and counts. Failed or cancelled work retains diagnostics and any published release; inspect before retry.
idempotency: Explicit retained mode borrows existing evidence without source writes. Omission selects fresh acquisition into this job's acquired directory; no global source pointer changes.
cancellation: Cooperative 30-minute wrapper deadline before app receipt commit; source publication finishes its bounded noncancellable commit or reports AK_PUBLICATION_INCOMPLETE. Cancelled control outcomes may retain complete or partial publication. OS stalls and forced termination are not transactionally recovered.
retention_profile: Preserve internal selected evidence, local-review-only normalized data and durable app job receipts. No automatic source deletion or record-level public export.
